title: Start the blocking input
hook: A tiny input task can unlock a much larger dependent task.

recall.question: A colleague's 2-hour build cannot start until you send a 5-minute config. You also have 30 minutes of tidying. What first?
recall.why: The short input releases the dependent build; doing the tidying first delays the build by 30 minutes.
